body.name: \(\mathbb B_{\mathcal A}(\Sigma_0,\delta_0)\)
body.construction: For each \(\Sigma\) with \(\|\Sigma-\Sigma_0\|_{\mathcal A}<\delta_0\), let \(Y_g=m_g+\Sigma_g^{1/2}\varepsilon_g\), where \(\varepsilon_g\) has independent Rademacher coordinates. Weyl's inequality gives \(\lambda_{\min}(\Sigma_g)>\lambda_0/2\), while \(\|\Sigma_g^{1/2}-\Sigma_{g0}^{1/2}\|_{\mathrm{op}}<\delta_0/\sqrt{\lambda_0}\); hence every coordinate of \(Y_g\) is at least \(d_0-\sqrt T\delta_0/\sqrt{\lambda_0}>d_0/2\), so \(\mathbb B_{\mathcal A}(\Sigma_0,\delta_0)\subset\mathcal L(m)\)
